reader.requirement: At --std 85 each USING file (file-name-2, file-name-3 and any further) is bounded by the sort-merge file: a variable-length file-name-1 refuses a USING file whose records are smaller than its smallest or larger than its largest record; a fixed-length file-name-1 refuses a USING file record larger than its largest record and admits a smaller one (space-filled by GR2).
